name: Dual-Rail Laboratory Optical Bench
semanticDescription: Standard dual-rod laboratory optical bench (1.0m) with millimeter metric scale, leveling feet, and three movable riders carrying an illuminated candle object, a lens holder, and a projection screen for focal length experiments (CBSE Class 10 Light Ch 9).
simplifications: Bench length scaled to 1.0 meter laboratory standard.
Vernier scale marks simplified to high-contrast measurement ticks.

materials.look: Polished stainless steel dual round guide rails
Black wrinkle-finish cast iron end feet and rider bases
Turned brass leveling screws, clamping knobs, and index pointers
